thread:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — consolidating action items into the sprint backlog. TL;DR: token validation flaky for refresh flow, audit gaps on secret deletion events, and a recurring monthly auth spike. Assign owners?
jordan: I'll take token validation hardening. Will open INF-7890 with a checklist. :white_check_mark:
sam: I'll own audit logging gaps — will add token lifecycle events and validate retention/permissions.
lee: I can coordinate secrets rotation schedule + runbook, and run KMS tests.
maya: Thanks. Jordan, please add acceptance criteria + perf targets (<0.1% validation error rate, p99 < 500ms). Sam add dashboard link when done.
jordan: Created INF-7890: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-7890. ETA end of sprint (2026-04-07). Tasks: reproduce, add unit tests, run e2e.
sam: INF-7901 opened for audit-events and dashboard work. Will instrument `audit.token.*` and add log sampling. ETA next Wed.
lee: For secrets rotation: proposing quarterly rotation with canary key rollover. Draft runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/SECRETS-ROTATION — will PR runbook this week.
maya: Also note recurring pattern — incidents spike in the first week of the month. Request: auto-detection + alerting for monthly spike. Metric proposal: `auth.incidents.monthly_spike` + alert to security-oncall.
priya: I'll prototype a detector using historical telemetry and changepoints. Putting draft in PR #412.
security-bot: PagerDuty integration created for token-validation-alerts.
ops-bridge: FYI deploy note: potential regression in commit 7f2c9a — https://git.redwood.ai/commit/7f2c9a flagged in rollback.
jordan: On tests — adding fuzzing for odd refresh-token formats. Quick repro snippet:
```
ERROR auth: token validation failed: missing kid
payload: {"alg":"none","sub":"svc"}
```
sam: For audit logs, I'll ensure both success and failure for refresh tokens are recorded, and add ELK dashboards + verify read perms for sec team.
maya: Action items summary (owners + timelines):
- INF-7890 (jordan) — token validation hardening — due EOW
- INF-7901 (sam) — audit events + dashboard — due next Wed
- SECRETS-ROTATE-PR (lee) — quarterly rotation runbook + canary tests — due next sprint
- DETECTOR-412 (priya) — monthly spike detector prototype — 2d
Please confirm owners and if timelines are realistic.
jordan: Confirmed.
sam: Confirmed.
lee: Confirmed, will ping infra for KMS soak tests.
priya: Confirmed, will post prototype link and metrics query.
maya: Great — weekly quick check-in Fridays 11:00am. I'll add a recurring calendar invite and update the postmortem doc with these action items. :calendar:
